semiconductor_relevance: High — CeramTec specializes in advanced ceramics that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: CeramTec GmbH is a leading manufacturer of advanced technical ceramics, providing precision-engineered ceramic solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. Their products, made from materials like alumina and silicon carbide, are designed to enhance performance in wafer handling and processing equipment.
capabilities: High-performance ceramic components for wafer handling
Precision-engineered ceramic solutions for semiconductor equipment
Materials with high thermal stability and long service life

regional_presence.Europe: CeramTec has a significant manufacturing presence in Germany, with its headquarters located in Plochingen near Stuttgart.
regional_presence.North America: The company operates subsidiaries in North America to support its global customer base.
regional_presence.Asia: CeramTec has production sites in Asia, enhancing its global reach and service capabilities.
